extDescription.message: Show and manage real Gmail labels (Gmail API) in Thunderbird, and suggest Gmail filters

errMissingScope.message: $1: missing permission, revoke then authorize the account again in the setup page

errNoClient.message: OAuth client not configured (ID and secret)

errNoCode.message: No OAuth code in the response

errNoRefresh.message: Google did not return a refresh token

errProposalExpired.message: Suggestion expired (replaced by a more recent one?)

barAuthExpired.message: Gmail Labels: authorization expired, renew it…

popupOffline.message: Offline: changes will be applied when back online.

popupOfflineQueued.message: Offline: changes will be applied when back online ($1 pending).

popupNone.message: This message is not in an IMAP account.

popupLocal.message: Offline and message never viewed online: cannot be changed.

filterIntro.message: “$1”$2 was filed under “$3”. Automatically label similar messages?

filterNoMatch.message: No existing message matches (check the criterion).

filterMatches.message: $1 existing message(s) match in the whole mailbox, $2 of them in the inbox.

filterExisting.message: Existing messages (the filter itself only applies to new incoming messages)

existingInbox.message: Also apply to those in the inbox

existingAll.message: Also apply to all of them (whole mailbox, 5,000 max)

filterIgnore.message: Don't suggest for this label again

filterNeedCriterion.message: Choose a criterion and at least one field.

optIntro.message: Follow the steps in order. Each step turns green once done.

step1Title.message: 1. Create your Google access (once, about 10 minutes)

step1Intro.message: The extension talks to Gmail through your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Sign in to Google Cloud with your Google account, then follow these sub-steps. Each “Open” button opens the right page in your browser.

s1a.message: Create a project (for example “thunderbird-labels”), then check it is selected at the top of the page.

s1c.message: Consent screen: “Get started” → app name, support email → audience “External” → contact email → accept → “Create”.

s1d.message: Data access → “Add or remove scopes” → paste these scopes into “Manually add scopes” → “Add to table” → “Update” → “Save”:

s1e.message: Audience → “Test users” → “Add users” → add your Gmail addresses:

s1f.message: Clients → “Create client” → type “Web application” → “Authorized redirect URIs” → add exactly this URI (with the trailing /) → “Create”. Keep the window showing the client ID and secret open for step 2:

step2Intro.message: Paste the client ID and secret shown by Google at the end of step 1.

clientIdInvalid.message: The client ID should end with .apps.googleusercontent.com

clientSecretWarn.message: Unusual secret: Google client secrets usually start with GOCSPX-.

step3Intro.message: Click “Authorize”: a Google window opens. Choose the right account; on “Google hasn't verified this app”, click “Continue” (it is your own app), then check the Gmail permissions. A check runs automatically afterwards.

step4Intro.message: While the Google app is “In testing”, Google asks to authorize again every 7 days. Once everything works: Audience → “Publish app”, then in step 3 click “Revoke” then “Authorize” for each account.

showBar.message: Show the label bar at the top of messages

proposeFilters.message: Suggest a Gmail filter when a message is moved to a label folder or a label is added

fixNetwork.message: Google cannot be reached: check the network connection, then retry.

fixTokenExpired.message: Authorization expired or revoked (7-day limit while the app is “In testing”): click “Revoke” then “Authorize”, and publish the app (step 4).

fixTokenClient.message: Google rejects the client: check the client ID and secret (step 2).

fixExpiry.message: Expires on $1: publish the app (step 4), then click “Revoke” and “Authorize”.

fixExpiryUnknown.message: Unknown for this authorization: click “Revoke” then “Authorize” once to find out.

fixScopes.message: Missing: $1. Add them in Data access (step 1), then click “Revoke” and “Authorize” again.

fixApiDisabled.message: The Gmail API is not enabled in the Google Cloud project (step 1).

fixAllMail.message: Subscribe to [Gmail]/All Mail (right-click the account → Subscribe…): needed to remove the label of the open folder instantly.
